ex.en: Clean water is a finite resource that we must protect.
ex.zh: 清洁的水是有限的资源，我们必须加以保护。

words.note: finite 与 infinite 相对，前缀 in- 表否定。

ex.en: Parliament voted to amend the law last month.
ex.zh: 议会上个月投票通过了这项法律的修订。

words.note: amend 多指修订法律或文件，比 change 正式。

ex.en: The volcano erupted for the first time in fifty years.
ex.zh: 这座火山五十年来第一次喷发。

words.note: erupt 既指火山喷发，也指暴力、掌声等突然爆发。

ex.en: The wooden box was decorated with exquisite carvings.
ex.zh: 这个木盒上装饰着精美的雕刻。

words.note: exquisite 强调精细优美，也可表“剧烈的”。

ex.en: Two buses collided on the icy road this morning.
ex.zh: 今天早上两辆公交车在结冰的路上相撞。

words.note: collide with 表与…相撞，名词为 collision。

ex.en: There is no simple remedy for the housing shortage.
ex.zh: 住房短缺问题没有简单的解决办法。

words.note: remedy 作动词表“补救”，如 remedy the situation。

ex.en: Honesty is a cardinal rule in scientific research.
ex.zh: 诚实是科学研究的一条基本准则。

words.note: cardinal 表“最重要的”，也指基数与红衣主教。

ex.en: The patient must give written consent before the operation.
ex.zh: 手术前病人必须给出书面同意。

words.note: consent 作名词不可数，常用 give consent。

ex.en: She insisted on paying for the meal herself.
ex.zh: 她坚持自己付饭钱。

words.note: insist 后接 on doing，也可接 that 从句。

ex.en: The new design is a fusion of traditional and modern elements.
ex.zh: 这个新设计融合了传统与现代元素。

words.note: fusion 指融合或核聚变，动词为 fuse。

ex.en: The volume of online sales doubled within two years.
ex.zh: 网上销售额在两年内翻了一番。

words.note: volume 可指音量、容积、卷册，也可指总量。

ex.en: Their partnership is based on mutual trust and respect.
ex.zh: 他们的合作建立在相互信任与尊重的基础上。

words.note: mutual 强调双方彼此，mutual friend 指共同的朋友。

ex.en: The road was closed, and therefore we had to take a detour.
ex.zh: 道路封闭了，因此我们只好绕行。

words.note: therefore 是正式连接副词，前常加 and 或用分号。

ex.en: They exchanged phone numbers before leaving the party.
ex.zh: 他们在离开聚会前交换了电话号码。

words.note: exchange 不用双宾语，说 exchange A for B。

ex.en: She was indignant at the way she had been treated.
ex.zh: 她对自己受到的待遇感到愤慨。

words.note: indignant 指因不公而愤慨，名词为 indignation。

ex.en: Please do not hesitate to contact me if you need help.
ex.zh: 如果需要帮助，请随时联系我，不必犹豫。

words.note: hesitate 后接 to do 或 about doing，不接 doing。

ex.en: Please round your answer to two decimal places.
ex.zh: 请把答案保留两位小数。

words.note: decimal place 指小数位，小数点说 decimal point。

ex.en: Many young people have become cynical about politics.
ex.zh: 许多年轻人对政治变得愤世嫉俗。

words.note: cynical 指不相信他人真诚，名词为 cynic 或 cynicism。

ex.en: You should ventilate the room after painting the walls.
ex.zh: 刷完墙后你应该给房间通通风。

words.note: ventilate 指使通风，也表“公开讨论”，名词 ventilation。

ex.en: He scooped up the coins from the table.
ex.zh: 他把桌上的硬币一把抓了起来。

words.note: scoop 在新闻中指抢先获得的独家报道。

ex.en: The old dog had been his faithful companion for years.
ex.zh: 这条老狗多年来一直是他忠实的伙伴。

words.note: companion 指同伴，a companion to sb 表某人的伙伴。

ex.en: The festival culminated in a spectacular firework display.
ex.zh: 节庆活动以一场壮观的烟火表演告终。

words.note: culminate 常与 in 连用，表最终达到某一结果。

ex.en: A serious breakdown in communication caused the long delay.
ex.zh: 严重的沟通中断造成了长时间的延误。

words.note: breakdown 指故障或关系破裂，动词短语为 break down。

ex.en: She found the number in the telephone directory.
ex.zh: 她在电话簿里找到了那个号码。

words.note: directory 指名录簿，电脑中的文件夹也叫 directory。

ex.en: The children behaved very well during the long journey.
ex.zh: 孩子们在长途旅行中表现得很好。

words.note: behave 可表举止，也可表机器运转，如 behave badly。

ex.en: She accomplished more in one year than most do in five.
ex.zh: 她一年取得的成就超过大多数人五年的成果。

words.note: accomplish 常与 task、goal 搭配，重音在第二音节。

ex.en: A single strand of hair was found at the scene.
ex.zh: 现场发现了一根头发。

words.note: strand 指一缕一股，动词常用被动 be stranded 表滞留。

ex.en: Each constituent part of the machine was tested separately.
ex.zh: 机器的每个组成部分都单独做了检测。

words.note: constituent 作名词指成分或选民，作形容词表“组成的”。

ex.en: The car engine started at the first attempt.
ex.zh: 汽车发动机一打就着了。

words.note: engine 也可指火车头，网络搜索工具叫 search engine。

ex.en: The smoke irritated her eyes and made her cough.
ex.zh: 烟刺激了她的眼睛，让她咳了起来。

words.note: irritate 既表使人恼火，也表刺激皮肤，名词 irritation。
